SIRAJ STRIKES BIG AND INDIA ARE ALL OVER! Mohammed Siraj bowling to Kyle Verreynne, good length ball, pitching outside off stump, Kyle Verreynne looking to block the ball coming in with the angle, his bat was behind the pad as the ball hit the pad first and then the bat. The umpire raises his finger, knowing it was pad first, they take the third and final review, and the replay shows a big spike when the ball was near the pad, and the tracking shows three reds! SA slide further as they lose their sixth! 

WICKET Kyle Verreynne lbw Mohammed Siraj (South Africa 146 Runs for 6 wickets)

OverHistory.UPDCommentry:
SIRAJ CLEANS UP HARMER! Mohammed Siraj bowling to Simon Harmer, good length ball, pitching outside off stump, the straightens after pitching, Harmer shoulders his arms, doesn't know where his off stump was- the ball sneaks past and hits the off-stumps! India needs just a wicket to bowl SA out! The Off-stump is just broken, and Siraj is elated! 

WICKET Simon Harmer b Mohammed Siraj (South Africa 153 Runs for 9 wickets)

SOUTH AFRICA GO 1-0 UP WITH 30-RUN VICTORY! Keshav Maharaj bowling to Mohammed Siraj, full length ball, pitching outside off stump, Mohammed Siraj edges one towards the slip and South Africa have done this!
